usedBy: Not used on its own. It is the amount block of every list with a value: Transaction List Read Only, Action, Selectable, Expandable and the child items. Pass these props in the item’s `amount` prop.
overview: Shows a formatted amount aligned to the end of the row, with an optional tag and one line of additional information.

default.title: Default
default.text: Neutral values, such as a payment or a transfer.

positive.title: Positive
positive.text: Money coming in. The block colors the value; don’t add a "+".

negative.title: Negative
negative.text: Money going out. The block adds the "-"; pass the value without a sign.

strikethrough.title: Strikethrough
strikethrough.text: A value that changed in the customer’s favor: the original is struck through and the new value is positive.

strikethroughNeutral.title: Strikethrough neutral
strikethroughNeutral.text: A value that changed with no gain or loss implied, such as an updated total.

withTag.title: With tag
withTag.text: One tag per row shows the status of the transaction. Its type comes from the product's status rules, such as `complementary` for Payment scheduled and `neutral` for Processing and Canceled. A canceled payment keeps its amount.

size.title: Size
size.text: `size="sm"` for secondary lists and child items; the tag follows it. In the items, `amount.size` is independent from `content.size`.

rules: Pass the value already formatted in R$ and without a sign.
Use `strikethrough` only when the change favors the customer; otherwise use `strikethrough-neutral`.
Use the tag for the status of the transaction; take its type from the product's status rules, such as `complementary` for Payment scheduled and `neutral` for Processing and Canceled.
Keep `info` to one short fact, such as "Advance fee".

api.value: Formatted value without a sign, such as "R$ 6.819,33". Required.
api.type: Adds the sign and the color. Ignored when the item is disabled.
api.strikethroughValue: Original value, struck through before `value`. Only with the strikethrough types.
api.tag: Status below the value, an Ocean Tag. Its size follows `size`; it turns neutral when the item is disabled.
api.info: One short fact about the value, such as "Advance fee".
api.size: Type scale of the block, independent from the content.
